description: Remove from Blocklist - Remove ONE email or domain from the blocklist (no lists or bulk input). Only entries added by hand (add_to_blocklist or the app's CSV upload) can be removed; entries created by an unsubscribe, a bounce, an API sync and older entries cannot. The removed address can be emailed again, so the user must approve it. Returns a preview first; the action runs only when called again with the returned confirmation_token after the user has approved the preview.

confirmation_token.description: Leave out on the first call. After the user has approved the preview, pass the confirmation_token that call returned.

email.description: The single email address or domain to remove

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: remove_from_blocklist

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Remove From Blocklist
